rbs.edtImport.title: Generate bookings from the Timetable
rbs.edtImport.help: What this tool does: for every course already published in the Timetable, it automatically creates, for the whole school year, the matching booking in Resource Booking — without you having to do it yourself, room by room. Nothing is created without your confirmation: start with "Preview". Example: the Maths teacher has a course every Monday from 8am to 9am in Room 102 with class 6th A. This course already exists in the Timetable, but Room 102 is not booked for that reason in Resource Booking — someone else could take it for that slot without knowing. After this import, it will be. Note: if the timetable is later regenerated or changed (a class moves to a different room, for example), run this import again so the bookings stay up to date — they do not update themselves.
rbs.edtImport.weekStart: Pick a week where courses are normally given
rbs.edtImport.weekStart.hint: A week without holidays is enough: the system finds every course that repeats each week there (e.g. the Monday 8am-9am Maths course) and books the same room for the whole year, not just for that week.
rbs.edtImport.weeksToScan: Over how many weeks should we look?
rbs.edtImport.weeksToScan.hint: 1 is enough if the timetable is the same every week. If some courses only happen every other week (week A/week B), set 2: the system will look at both weeks so no course is missed, then book them all for the rest of the year.
rbs.edtImport.periodicEndDate: Until when should the bookings last?
rbs.edtImport.periodicEndDate.hint: Usually the end of the school year.
rbs.edtImport.error: An error occurred, nothing was created.
rbs.edtImport.missingDates: Choose a week and an end date first before continuing.

rbs.edtImport.report.conflicts.hint: These slots won't be created because the room is already taken by someone else at that time. Handle manually if needed.
rbs.edtImport.report.unmatchedRooms: Room not found among resources (not created)
rbs.edtImport.report.unmatchedRooms.hint: The room name shown in the Timetable does not match any resource already recorded. Check the spelling or create the matching resource.
rbs.edtImport.report.obsolete: Bookings that no longer match anything (to cancel)
rbs.edtImport.report.obsolete.hint: Example: last time, this same tool booked Room 102 for the Monday 8am Maths course. Since then, that course was moved to Room 105 in the Timetable (or removed) — the Room 102 booking now serves no purpose and would needlessly block that room. Clicking "Confirm" cancels it at the same time the new bookings are created.
